title: Become a Member
intro: Join naNODE and become part of a growing network of students and alumni from the Nanoscience programme at the University of Copenhagen.
why_join: Membership gives you access to social and professional events, networking opportunities and a community spanning different stages of the nanoscience career path.
who_can_join: Membership is open to current students and graduates of the Nanoscience programme at the University of Copenhagen, including those who have completed a bachelor's degree, master's degree or PhD.
membership_fee: Membership is free for current students. Alumni membership is 100 DKK per year.
